reason: The only proposal (D-4e8196) is about redirects in utils, not docstring style; Google-style Args: is used in ~29 files, reST :param in ~7 files.
No proposal concerns docstring arg types; most Args entries carry (type), but several in utils/ (e.g. utils/search/__init__.py, utils/mail.py) omit it.
No proposal concerns docstring punctuation; grep shows most typed arg entries (~55 of ~86) do not end with a period.
No proposal concerns template tag signatures; about half of tags with defaults (display_user, display_pack, bw_icon, sound_carousel, display_facet, selectors) lack the `*` separator.
No proposal concerns template tag call syntax; bw_icon's optional class_name is passed positionally ~36 times and never by keyword, though other tags use keywords.
No proposal concerns Django permissions; all four custom permissions are in Meta.permissions of related models.
No proposal concerns permission groups; all four custom permissions appear in user_groups.json groups.
No proposal concerns parameter_user access; no view reads request.parameter_user directly and get_parameter_user_or_404 is used 24 times.
No proposal concerns view decorators; most username-in-URL views use redirect_if_old_username, but sounds.views downloaders, pack_downloaders, pack_licenses and attribution_modal do not.
No proposal concerns view decorators; no @login_required view also uses @redirect_if_old_username.
No proposal concerns raise_404_if_user_is_deleted; many user-scoped public views use it, though applicability is a judgement call per view.
No proposal concerns decorator order; every combined use has redirect_if_old_username directly above raise_404_if_user_is_deleted.
No proposal concerns migrations; 21 of ~208 migrations contain RunPython data migrations, some of them copying data.
No proposal concerns migrations; several AddFields on large tables (profile, soundanalysis) use defaults rather than null=True.
No proposal concerns Profile anonymization; delete_user clears about, home_page, signature, geotag, avatar but not sound_signature.
No proposal concerns DeletedSound; on_delete_sound copies all Sound fields generically via values() and serializes the date fields.
No proposal concerns JS modals; all modal components except a few page scripts use handleGenericModal(WithForm).
No proposal concerns search options; all options are SearchOption* definitions in SearchQueryProcessor.option_definitions.
No proposal concerns query_params; they are built in SearchQueryProcessor.as_query_params and passed through.
No proposal concerns the search template; options are rendered there, 14 via display_search_option.
No proposal concerns search backends; both engine classes derive from SearchEngineBase.
No proposal concerns metrics; all metric emission uses prometheus_client Counter .inc().
No proposal concerns metric placement; each counter is defined in the single module that increments it.
No proposal concerns builtin shadowing; ruff A rules (minus A001/A002 ignores) are enforced in CI and pre-commit.
No proposal concerns bugbear patterns; ruff B is enforced in CI with listed ignores.
No proposal concerns pycodestyle; ruff E is enforced in CI with listed ignores.
No proposal concerns pyflakes; the D-4e8196 redirect proposal is unrelated and ruff F is enforced in CI.
No proposal concerns import sorting; ruff I is enforced in CI.
No proposal concerns bandit patterns; ruff S is enforced in CI with listed ignores.
No proposal concerns flake8-django; ruff DJ is enforced in CI with listed ignores.
No proposal concerns flake8-pie; ruff PIE is enforced in CI.
No proposal concerns pylint errors; ruff PLE is enforced in CI.
No proposal concerns JS; prettier semi:true is configured, but at least one statement in tagsFormField.js lacks a semicolon.
No proposal concerns JS; the rule is warn-level, eslint isn't run in CI, and unused vars can't be verified by grep.
No proposal concerns JS globals; grep finds no reassignment of $, d3, Highcharts, mapboxgl or MapboxGeocoder.
